name: SAMEDIFF_TRAINING
description: Performs one training iteration (fit) on a SameDiff model using input data.

parameters.name: modelUri
parameters.description: URI of the saved SameDiff model file to load and train (e.g., 'file:/path/to/model.fb', 'classpath:/models/model.fb').

parameters.name: modelSaveOutputPath
parameters.description: Optional path where the updated model will be saved after the training iteration. If null, the model is not saved.

parameters.name: inputFeatures
parameters.description: List of keys in the input Data object corresponding to the model's feature input variables.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: List of keys in the input Data object corresponding to the model's label input variables (placeholders).

parameters.name: targetVariables
parameters.description: List of the model's output variable names that correspond to the predictions used in loss calculation (must match order of 'labels' and 'lossVariables').

parameters.name: lossVariables
parameters.description: List of the loss variable names defined in the SameDiff graph (must match order of 'labels' and 'targetVariables'). If 'lossFunction' is specified, these can be auto-generated.

parameters.name: lossFunction
parameters.description: Optionally specify a standard loss function to add/use. If specified, 'lossVariables' can potentially be omitted (uses default naming) or used to name the generated loss ops. Requires 'labels' and 'targetVariables' to be set.

parameters.name: updaterConfig
parameters.description: Configuration for the ND4J IUpdater as a JSON/Map object. Requires 'updaterClass' and parameters specific to that updater (e.g., 'learningRate'). Example: {'updaterClass': 'Adam', 'learningRate': 0.001, 'beta1': 0.9, 'beta2': 0.999}

parameters.name: weightDecayApplyLearningRate
parameters.description: Whether to apply learning rate to weight decay. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: initialLossType
parameters.description: Data type for loss calculation placeholders if dynamically added (e.g., FLOAT, DOUBLE). Defaults to FLOAT.
